key_insight: Lexicographically minimizing idle range, maximum idle, then total idle improves waiting times while preserving the best balance among participants.
engineering_relevance: Compact MaxSAT encodings can reduce scheduling model size and memory demand while preserving feasible schedules, objective costs, and optimization priorities.
method: Measure waiting as empty slots between each participant’s first and last meetings.
Compare idle totals among participants requesting at least two meetings.
Use Compact-Base for feasibility encoding and Compact-Objective for additional objective-specific compression.
evidence_signal: Across 226 variants of 20 base instances with three repetitions per configuration, Compact-Objective had the lowest median clause count in all nine objective–dataset comparisons; among 84 jointly optimal instances, selected lexicographic schedules reduced maximum idle on 11 and total idle on 56 versus selected range-only schedules.
watch_item: Smaller encodings did not guarantee faster solving: runtime rankings varied even with the same solver build and computing environment.
paper_title: Compact MaxSAT Encodings for Balanced Waiting in B2B Meeting Scheduling
